part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 78% chance that the U.S. Commerce Department will officially institute mandatory quarterly supply chain audits for all foreign cloud providers operating under BIS Affiliates Rule compliance requirements before January 2027.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce / Bureau of Industry and Security
resolution_criteria.metric: Official publication of mandatory quarterly audit regulations for foreign cloud affiliates
resolution_criteria.threshold: Formal publication in the Federal Register or official BIS administrative update

baseline.value: Zero mandatory quarterly supply chain audits enforced as an across-the-board rule

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: administrative rule; status: officially enacted and published; window: prior to January 2027; excludes: voluntary guidelines or draft proposals not finalized.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 68% chance that the European Commission will formally issue a binding harmonization directive requiring all EuroHPC AI Factories to adopt standardized sovereign security protocols prior to February 2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: Official adoption of a binding harmonization directive for AI Factory security protocols
resolution_criteria.threshold: Formal legal adoption and publication in the Official Journal of the European Union

baseline.value: Decentralized security protocols managed independently by individual EuroHPC sites

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: binding European directive; status: formally adopted; window: prior to February 2028; excludes: non-binding recommendations, working group whitepapers, or draft proposals.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 72% chance that the U.S. International Trade Commission will initiate a formal Section 332 investigation into foreign cloud service providers and semiconductor import dependencies before December 2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: Formal initiation of a Section 332 investigation published in the Federal Register
resolution_criteria.threshold: Official notice of investigation published by USITC

baseline.value: No active comprehensive Section 332 investigation specifically targeting foreign cloud providers and semiconductor dependencies combined

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: formal investigation notice; status: initiated and published; window: prior to December 2028; excludes: preliminary staff inquiries or congressional hearing requests without formal commission initiation.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 62% chance that the U.S. Commerce Department will officially expand Is-Informed export licensing requirements to include all non-U.S. developers training foundation models exceeding 10^26 FLOPs before June 2029.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce / Bureau of Industry and Security
resolution_criteria.metric: Official issuance of Is-Informed export control directives covering global training runs above threshold
resolution_criteria.threshold: Formal publication or direct administrative notification of expanded export control scope

baseline.value: Export controls on foundation models targeted selectively at specific named entities like Anthropic

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: administrative export control directive; status: officially issued; window: prior to June 2029; excludes: voluntary industry safety pacts or unbinding agency guidance memos.
